text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Haa... whew...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I won...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I've grown dull. I must train myself 
anew..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Which means next year will mark your 
full-scale debut into racing, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Me too. I'd be really happy if we could 
run together again somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I need no flattery. Even without me, there 
are myriad others who could entertain you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Underclassmen, huh. Indeed... the way 
they push themselves forward is beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash—she's strong. But next time, 
I won't let her get away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No matter the opponent, what I must do 
does not change.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Steadily produce results in the Senior 
Class like this. And then—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To me, full of pride...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm all right. Though I'll admit, it 
was a tough battle."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than worrying, right now, please 
offer words befitting a victor."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Every opponent was tougher than 
expected, but... I delivered results.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After going through such a tough battle, I 
still truly believe that this path was the 
right one...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's stick to the original plan and run 
in GⅠ races during the Senior year as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First is the opening race of the Spring 
Senior Triple Crown, the Osaka Hai, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...There's something on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Alles in Ordnung— Everything is going well 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We fully expected the Senior Class runners 
to be formidable. Even knowing that, this 
is the path we chose to walk.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And that battle ended in victory. I shall 
grow even more next year, so it will not 
be quite as fierce as today's.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—Would it be... premature of me to feel 
confident that we can see this schedule 
through to the end?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――Ja, hallo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And for a short while, Eishin Flash 
appeared to be talking with her parents, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ――Wirklich!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It looks like my father and mother are 
coming to Japan to watch my race...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm very happy...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, I am also surprised. My parents 
are very busy and methodical people."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even during the Selection Race, my 
schedule for coming to Japan had already 
been set back when I decided to study 
abroad.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, I think they would have decided 
that much earlier, but..."
choice_data_list: I just really, really want to see you run.
I just really, really want to see you run.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. My parents said the same thing.
choice_data_list: When did you say they're coming?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It seems they were able to make 
arrangements for the latter half of 
October next year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I think about the races scheduled for 
that period. According to Eishin Flash's 
plans—"
choice_data_list: It's time for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
It's time for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's train so that we can peak right 
at that moment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I must keep my promise.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘I will show you how much I’ve grown.’ 
...That is the promise I just made to my 
parents."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To run the best race possible in front of 
the two of them— and to seize victory 
every step of the way leading up to it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I ended up saying... that I wouldn't lose 
in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Did I say too much?
choice_data_list:
I plan on winning every single race right 
from the start.

I intend to keep winning right from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I'll send the race details to my 
parents."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I ponder while seeing Eishin Flash off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, famous Umamusume who had settled 
down after defining an era have been 
making active returns to race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What on earth was happening right now? A 
slight sense of foreboding lingered ahead 
of the Osaka Hai—
